purpose: Source-led opportunities that people can attend, influence or watch. A listing is an invitation to inspect the organiser's page, not a GAJRA Earth endorsement.

records.title: Forum on AI and Citiverse
records.timeLabel: Programme times published by the organiser
records.organiser: ITU, UN-Habitat and the City of Tampere
records.summary: A forum on interoperable and scalable urban innovation, including how AI enters the systems and public spaces of cities.
records.jraQuestion: Whose ordinary life becomes easier, who carries the risk, and which local knowledge remains visible?

records.title: First meeting of the Focus Group on AI for Smart Sustainable Cities and Communities
records.timeLabel: Programme times published by the organiser
records.summary: The opening meeting of an ITU focus group exploring AI in smart and sustainable cities and communities.
records.jraQuestion: Which civic choices stay with communities as connected systems become more capable?

records.title: Machine learning for ICT infrastructure detection
records.timeLabel: 14:00 to 15:00, confirm the displayed timezone with the organiser
records.summary: An online session about using machine learning to detect ICT infrastructure, with implications for access, planning and the visibility of missing infrastructure.
records.jraQuestion: Does better visibility widen access, and who decides what the model is allowed to overlook?

records.title: Computational and data opportunities for weather and climate modelling
records.timeLabel: 17:00 to 18:00, confirm the displayed timezone with the organiser
records.summary: An online session exploring computational and data opportunities for weather and climate modelling.
records.jraQuestion: How can stronger forecasting capability return useful time and agency to the communities living with the weather?

records.title: AI for Climate Innovation Factory live pitching session
records.timeLabel: 16:00 to 17:00, confirm the displayed timezone with the organiser
records.summary: The first 2026 live pitching session for AI and climate projects.
records.jraQuestion: Which proposals connect climate capability to responsibility, shared benefit and lived joy?
